riskSignals.rationale: Official homepage links separate food, brunch/dessert, drink, and whiskey/menu surfaces.
Menu descriptions and global peanut-oil warning do not provide a complete item-level allergen matrix or cross-contact status.
Chicken & Waffles, Honey Butter Chicken Biscuit, Fried Chicken Sandwich, and Brunchy Fried Rice appear in multiple service sections and were consolidated explicitly.
Official menu states that peanut oil is used in fryers.
Official drink menu contains nonalcoholic products outside the frozen food baseline.

findings.summary: No complete restaurant-issued allergen or ingredient matrix was located. Explicit positive ingredients were retained narrowly, while absent allergens and cross-contact remain unavailable.
Two frozen baseline rows are service-level modifiers/navigation text rather than standalone products: all served with a side of house-made chips; comes with mixed greens or house-made chips.
Official menu states that peanut oil is used in fryers; item-specific shared-fryer status is not disclosed.

scout.summary: Barrel's official Washington DC food and drink menus are current and accessible. The 42 frozen baseline rows reconcile once: 40 exact current products and 2 baseline artifacts representing service-level modifiers. Duplicate food presentations were consolidated. The official menu explicitly lists peanut oil in fryers, but no complete allergen matrix or cross-contact disclosure was found, so allergen evidence is partial-positive-only or unavailable and the result remains a candidate for Terra review.
